shots.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single full-bleed landscape 16:9 concept still for an interactive exhibition pitch. NOT a collage of panels, no captions, lettering or watermark. Core concept: a real adult visitor captured by webcam with chroma key, their photoreal face/upper body/hands composited as a GIANT in a miniature stylized city with very tiny cute residents. Render the final screen composite, not an exhibition room. No green screen visible, headsets, controllers or camera hardware. People must look unmistakably photographic, environments must look tactile crafted paper / experimental shadow puppetry, with a deliberate real-versus-illustrated contrast. Tiny original ivory bean-shaped inhabitants with dot eyes, stubby limbs and tiny scarves or ribbons; small and vulnerable charm associated with Chiikawa but original designs. Residents should look fingertip-sized or smaller relative to the human, not normal-sized people. Surreal strange theatrical atmosphere in the spirit of Madoka Magica witch labyrinths: whimsical, uncanny, graphically sophisticated rather than generic fantasy. Playful grabbing/eating/throwing mechanics, no injury, blood or realistic violence. Clear visual hierarchy, dynamic asymmetry. Avoid ornate European fantasy castle skylines, lace, cake-like architecture, generic cute pastel city. DIRECTION: BLACK AND WHITE SHADOW THEATRE, strictly charcoal black and ivory with tiny scarlet accents. Scene is a claustrophobic vertical apartment canyon made from jagged torn black paper rectangular apartment blocks, stark white windows, hanging laundry silhouettes and little external fire escapes. Low-angle wide shot looking up between buildings. A huge photographic adult East Asian woman's face with black bob is seen in monochrome peeking between two towers in upper left, only face and one hand visible, face curious and mischievous. Her enormous realistic index finger approaches one tiny red-scarfed white resident standing on an open window ledge at center-right. Many other tiny residents peek out from scattered windows, most much smaller, windows create a rhythmic pattern. Deep empty black shapes contrast with large ivory negative space, paper grain, scratched ink, shadow puppet silhouettes, slight red hand-drawn surprise ticks near the selected resident. Residents and window ledge stay readable. Strong urban density, no spires, no moon required, no curved road.
